title: thymus longicaulis var. antalyanus
intro: Thymus longicaulis var. antalyanus, commonly known as Turkish thyme or Antalya thyme, is a variety of the thyme plant that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Turkish thyme include its use as an antiseptic, antispasmodic, and expectorant, making it beneficial for respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Turkish thyme include thymol and carvacrol, which are responsible for its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects.
